description: This file appears to be a PHP script for the TestLink open-source test management tool. It provides functionality for creating direct links to specific test cases, requirements, requirement specifications, and test suites within the TestLink project, including session management, security checks, URL construction, and displaying appropriate frames based on request parameters. It also includes functions for handling external file dependencies, processing different item types, and managing cookies related to these items.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, providing methods to fetch project data by prefix and manage session project context.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Handles test case data operations, such as retrieving internal IDs and managing test case related links.

methods.name: checkTestProject
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to view or manage a given test project based on the prefix.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and parses GET parameters to construct an object with request data for further processing.

methods.name: buildLink
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters based on provided arguments object for navigating within the application.

methods.name: process_testcase
methods.description: Builds a link and manages session cookies for a specific test case identified by its external ID.

methods.name: process_req
methods.description: Builds a link and manages cookies for a requirement, optionally verifying version existence.

methods.name: process_reqspec
methods.description: Builds link for a requirement specification and handles associated cookies.

methods.name: buildCookie
methods.description: Creates a cookie structure based on the item's path in the project tree for session management.

methods.name: process_testsuite
methods.description: Generates a link for a test suite, including setting session cookies.
